metadata.description: Tellers skills for AI agents: edit, preview and export video locally with the Tellers player, or edit Tellers projects through the Tellers MCP.

plugins.name: tellers-otio-player
plugins.description: Build a Tellers OTIO timeline from local files or URLs, embed the single-file Tellers player in HTML and preview and export it on localhost. No account needed.

plugins.name: tellers-mcp
plugins.description: Connect the hosted Tellers MCP (https://mcp.tellers.ai/) and use it for AI video editing with live previews.
